author: Michael Larabel
description: With Debian voting to allow the responsible use of generative AI, there is now a new initiative funded by Scaleway to make it easier for Debian contributors to leverage AI: the Debian Inference Portal...
title: Debian Inference Portal Launches To Provide Free AI/LLM Inferencing To Debian Developers

author: Michael Larabel
description: Qualcomm at their Snapdragon Summit taking place in Hawaii are talking up the forthcoming Linux support for Snapdragon X2 series laptops...
title: Qualcomm Talks Up Linux On Snapdragon X2 Laptops

author: Michael Larabel
description: The AMD-aligned Lemonade open-source project for serving as a local AI server released 2026.39.1 today as well as issuing a release candidate of 2026.40 as their next release. Besides adapting to a new versioning scheme, the Lemonade SDK updates today bring a few notable changes...
title: Lemonade Fixes AMD APU Model Streaming, Drops OpenMOSS ROCm As ~40x Slower Than Vulkan

author: Michael Larabel
description: Intel engineers have been quietly developing dxvk-igdext as their own component for DXVK Direct3D 8 / 9 / 10 / 11 atop the Vulkan API for leveraging Intel Direct3D 11 Graphics Extensions...
title: Intel Developing Their DXVK-IGDEXT For Improved Linux Gaming On Arc Graphics

author: Michael Larabel
description: With the recent release of Java/OpenJDK 27 I began some fresh benchmarks in not having looked at the OpenJDK Java performance in a few years. Carried away, I ended up re-testing all the major OpenJDK versions going back to the venerable JDK 8.
title: Benchmarking Java Performance Of JDK 8 Through OpenJDK 27

author: Michael Larabel
description: NTFS-3G 2026.9.18 was released this morning as the newest update to this FUSE-based open-source driver for NTFS file-system support...
title: NTFS-3G Update Brings Many Security Fixes

author: Michael Larabel
description: In addition to AMD working on AVX10_V2_AUX support for the GCC compiler, this summer they also posted AVX10_V2_AUX support for the LLVM/Clang compiler. As of yesterday that enablement was merged for LLVM 24 for that important step toward AI Compute Extensions (ACE)...
title: AMD Upstreams AVX10_V2_AUX Support Into LLVM Clang 24

author: Michael Larabel
description: Merged at the start of the Linux 7.3 kernel cycle was adding Logitech Bolt USB receiver support for Logitech HID++ devices to the hid-logitech-dj driver code. That has resulted in too many bug reports of early Linux 7.3 users encountering varying issues with their Logitech mice that the functionality is now being reverted until it can be better developed...
title: Linux 7.3 Reverting Logitech Bolt Receiver HID++ After Too Many Bugs Encountered
